title: Career Roadmap · Video Editor
summary: A Video Editor turns raw footage into polished stories for films, social media, advertisements, news, documentaries, gaming and digital content.

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: Any stream; arts, media and computer subjects can help.

blocks.label: Useful subjects
blocks.text: English, visual arts, computer applications and media studies.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Storytelling, shot selection, pacing, sound, colour and transitions.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Attention to detail, visual judgment, file organization and communication.

blocks.label: Entrance
blocks.text: Design and film institutes may require aptitude tests, interviews or portfolios; requirements vary.

items.text: Diploma in Video Editing / Post-Production → Practical editing and production workflow.
Diploma in Film / Television / Multimedia → Editing plus broader media-production skills.
BA in Film, Television or Mass Communication → Editing for films, news and digital media.
B.Des. / Visual Communication → Branded content, motion graphics and visual storytelling.
B.Sc. in Animation / VFX / Multimedia → Editing combined with compositing and digital production.

blocks.label: Admission
blocks.text: Check each institution’s current eligibility, portfolio requirements and entrance process.
Government / Public

items.text: Film and Television Institute of India (FTII), Pune — film and television training; verify current editing programmes.
Satyajit Ray Film and Television Institute (SRFTI), Kolkata — film and television education; check current editing specializations.
Jamia Millia Islamia, New Delhi — media and mass communication programmes.
Government Film and Television Institute, Bengaluru — film/television training; verify current course availability.
National Institute of Design (NID), Ahmedabad — design and visual communication; editing-specific training may vary.

blocks.text: Private

items.text: Whistling Woods International, Mumbai — filmmaking and post-production-related programmes.
AAFT, Noida — film, television and media-related training.
MIT Institute of Design, Pune — design and visual communication.
Symbiosis Centre for Media & Communication, Pune — media production and communication.
Srishti Manipal Institute of Art, Design and Technology, Bengaluru — creative media and digital arts-related study.

blocks.text: These are institutions to investigate, not a ranking. Confirm exact editing courses, software facilities, practical projects, fees and admissions on official websites.

blocks.label: Government
blocks.text:
National Scholarship Portal — check eligible central/state schemes.
Scholarships
+1

blocks.label: Andhra Pradesh
blocks.text: Check current post-matric scholarships and fee-support schemes through official state portals.

blocks.label: Institutional aid
blocks.text: Ask about merit awards, need-based aid and fee concessions.

blocks.label: International
blocks.text: Explore university-specific scholarships and bursaries.
Eligibility and percentage cutoffs vary by scheme and institution. Verify current official notification.

blocks.label: Year 1
blocks.text: Editing basics, shot selection, continuity, file organization and storytelling.

blocks.label: Year 2
blocks.text: Sound editing, colour correction, transitions, titles and motion graphics.

blocks.label: Year 3
blocks.text: Advanced editing, client briefs, collaborative production and internships.

blocks.label: Year 4, if applicable
blocks.text: Final showreel, major project and job/PG applications.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Short narrative film; social-media campaign; documentary edit; before-and-after colour-grading reel.

blocks.label: Film / media
blocks.text: Production houses, TV channels, post-production studios and documentary teams.

blocks.label: Private sector
blocks.text: Advertising agencies, digital-content studios, YouTube production teams and corporate video companies.

blocks.label: Potential employers
blocks.text: Film studios, broadcasters, OTT production vendors and creative agencies; check official career pages.

blocks.label: Ideal areas
blocks.text: Assistant editing, footage logging, rough cuts, sound synchronization and colour correction.
Internships and placements are not guaranteed.

blocks.label: Digital route
blocks.text: Editing skills + motion graphics → Social Media / Digital Video Editor.
Relevant programmes

items.text: MFA in Cinema — Film Editing.
MFA in Electronic and Digital Media — Editing.
Postgraduate certificate / diploma in TV Editing.
Postgraduate study in Film, Digital Media or Post-Production.

blocks.text: Institutions to explore

items.text:
FTII, Pune — one-year postgraduate TV course specializing in Video Editing; published eligibility requires a bachelor’s degree.
FTII

SRFTI, Kolkata — MFA in Cinema with Film Editing specialization; graduate-entry route.
Satyajit Ray Film & Television Institute
+1
Whistling Woods International, Mumbai — verify current post-production offerings.
Jamia Millia Islamia, New Delhi — explore current media-related postgraduate programmes.
Other recognized film and media institutes offering editing specializations.

blocks.label: Specializations
blocks.text: Film editing, television, documentaries, advertising, social-media content, trailers, colour grading and motion graphics.

items.text: Assistant Video Editor
Video Editor
Film / TV Editor
Social Media Video Editor
Corporate Video Editor
Promo / Trailer Editor

blocks.label: With experience
blocks.text: Senior Editor, Post-Production Supervisor or Editing Director

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Film, TV, OTT, advertising, news, education, gaming, corporate communications and digital marketing.
Technical skills

items.text: Continuity, pacing and narrative structure
Audio cleanup and synchronization
Colour correction and grading
Titles, transitions and basic motion graphics
Media management, backups and export formats

blocks.text: Tools / technologies

items.text: Adobe Premiere Pro
DaVinci Resolve
Final Cut Pro
Adobe After Effects
Audition or equivalent audio tools

blocks.text: Useful certifications

items.text:
Adobe Certified Professional — Digital Video Using Premiere.
Adobe Certified Professional
+1
Adobe After Effects / motion-graphics certification where relevant.
DaVinci Resolve training and certification resources.

blocks.text: Certification is optional; a strong editing showreel and reliable delivery skills are essential for demonstrating ability.

blocks.label: Countries to explore
blocks.text: UK, Canada, USA, Australia and France.
Institutions to investigate

items.text: UK — Bournemouth University, film and television-related programmes.
Canada — Vancouver Film School, film production and post-production training.
USA — American Film Institute, postgraduate film programmes.
Australia — Griffith University, screen production-related study.
France — GOBELINS, animation and digital-production programmes.

blocks.text: Common requirements

items.text: Academic records and English proficiency where applicable.
Portfolio / showreel or practical assessment where required.
Relevant prerequisites; some postgraduate programmes require a degree.
Passport, financial evidence and applicable student-visa documents.

blocks.text: Verify current programme names, editing specializations, fees and admissions on official institution websites.

blocks.label: Roles
blocks.text: Assistant Editor, Video Editor, Film Editor, Post-Production Assistant, Motion Graphics Editor.

blocks.label: Markets
blocks.text: UK, Canada, Australia, USA and France.

items.text: Direct employment is possible, but depends on portfolio quality, experience, vacancies and work authorization. Sponsorship is not guaranteed.

blocks.text: Media Student ↓ Editing Trainee / Intern ↓ Assistant Video Editor ↓ Video Editor ↓ Senior Editor / Specialist ↓ Post-Production Supervisor ↓ Editing Director / Post-Production Lead / Studio Owner

CLASS 10 / 12 ↓ VIDEO EDITING DIPLOMA / FILM OR MEDIA DEGREE ↓ EDITING + SOUND + COLOUR + STORYTELLING ↓ PROJECTS + SHOWREEL + INTERNSHIP ↓ ASSISTANT EDITOR / JUNIOR VIDEO EDITOR ↓ VIDEO EDITOR → SENIOR / SPECIALIST ↓ POST-PRODUCTION LEAD / EDITING DIRECTOR
